mechanism_narrative: A sustained above-average FEDFUNDS rate (compared to the past 12 months) signals ongoing monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is not above its 12-month average but 20-day returns are negative, or FEDFUNDS is above average but returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in UNRATE below 4.0% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains above 4.0% but 20d returns are positive, or UNRATE drops below 4.0% but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) outpaces supply (INDPRO), it signals imbalances favoring corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 ≤ INDPRO but 60d returns are positive, or GDPC1 > INDPRO but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), accommodative monetary policy signals support for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL ≥ 2.0% but 20d returns are positive, or CPIAUCSL < 2.0% but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in UNRATE above 4.0% signals labor market weakening, reducing corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE ≤ 4.0% but 60d returns are negative, or UNRATE > 4.0% but returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (HOUST) outpaces supply (INDPRO), it indicates excess corporate demand, driving up stock prices and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST ≤ INDPRO but 20d returns are positive, or HOUST > INDPRO but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 3% MoM), sustained demand growth signals peak nearness but continued investor optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If in the late-cycle expansion regime but 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or outside the regime but returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% signals tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.5% but 20d returns are negative, or FEDFUNDS > 2.5% but returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.
